answer: The sieve is Certified ferryman toll log with ferrymen confirmation. It lets through the agent who paid 5-year yard service, 142 supervised collections, craft exam, annual re-assessment and catches everything else. Each alias adds 113 POA of risk, so 554 aliases carry 62602 POA of risk against a single epoch's reward. Put the river on the table, put the tundra next to it, and put the dune underneath: the pile is the proof. An honest agent passes once; a farm pays a hundred times and still fails.
